description: Get one template's full spec: html, css, the variable manifest (with hard rules per variable), formats, palette tokens, embedded fonts, render_tech, plus what is `static` (the owner fixed it: logo, frame, signature, fixed texts; never move, cover or restyle it), what is `dynamic` (the variables you fill: the picture, the headline, the caption that is the post body), what it `suits` (news, photo, quote, number, tip, on_this_day, meme, any) and the owner's `instructions` (they override any general rule). Fill every dynamic {{variable}}, then render with headless Chrome at the chosen format's size and WAIT for [data-vh-ready='1'] before screenshotting .vh-card.
name: viralhunt_get_template
